reviewed_by: Claude: command-runtime-unavailable notice, focused harness/subagent/importer selection
reason: Harness sessions in a Docker-mode project with no prepared command runtime silently lost run_command/process_io while metadata claimed command_runtime_enabled. Sessions now record command_runtime_unavailable with runtime_info detail, report command_runtime_enabled False, keep graph tools, record one warning diagnostic per session build, emit one warning notice per session on its first turn, tell the model in developer instructions, and roll over to a commands-capable session when the runtime is prepared or the project switches to Host mode. The subagent capability catalog returns unavailable_reason. The 2.x importer writes default_host_policy like new projects. Selected: the new and changed harness command-runtime tests plus tests whose fakes gained command_runtime_unavailable_detail, the importer and subagent catalog files, and harness turn lifecycle for the turn-start path that now emits the notice.
exclusions: No UI change: the notice is a severity=warning harness notice, which harnessActivity already places in the transcript tier, so no frontend or Playwright selection. Native provider chats still raise AutomationRuntimeUnavailable unchanged. tests/v3/test_harnesses.py is selected by node id because test_knowledge_access_change_refreshes_fixed_gateway_catalog and test_browser_attachment_refreshes_catalog_without_replacing_native_thread already fail on origin/main 01852b9 (HarnessInstructionContextChanged) independent of this change. No settings change, so no settings catalog or assistant update. No full-suite approval.
